$comment: The `dot` binding is an InferOpsDotSession from the inferops gatekeeper (custom-gatekeepers/gatekeeper-inferops). blueprintId is the install key: never rename it.
title: InferOps Dot
description: Use to talk to your own InferOps Dot in one InferOps workspace: ask it, follow its answer as it comes, and see each change it proposes and where that change stands. Every change waits for your decision under Needs your approval; the Dot makes none itself. Needs your own Dot connected as the `dot` binding. The connection is private to the person who made it, so a gadget using it cannot be shared.

dot.title: Your InferOps Dot
dot.description: Your own Dot in one InferOps workspace, e.g. inferops://acme.operations/chatbot/dot.
